visual.shell: warm off-white segmented ABS torso with broad soft radii
visual.lower_chassis: matte charcoal base and telescoping mast
visual.head: masked black sensor visor in off-white housing
visual.status_lights: blue vertical system light, white front, amber side markers

chassis.cover_material: 2 mm ABS shell on aluminium deck and extrusion frame

drive.motor_family: 12 V 80 RPM high-torque 37 mm gearmotor with quadrature encoder

head.mask: smoked polycarbonate visor over camera, illuminator and optional pico projector
head.optional_projector: 5 V pico projector, disabled from baseline BOM

power.mast_converter: 12.8 V to isolated 24 V 10 A or dedicated 24 V lift supply

safety.guarded_service_estop: rear recessed under a flip guard; reachable by test staff

sensors.lidar: LD06/LD19-class 2D lidar on fixed base roof
sensors.masked_head: stereo/dual camera behind replaceable smoked polycarbonate visor
sensors.encoders: quadrature on each motor or one encoder per side minimum
sensors.bumper: front and rear floating bars, four NC microswitches
sensors.tilt: dual-axis hardware tilt switch plus IMU software monitor

compute.baseline: Raspberry Pi 5 4 GB with active cooling
compute.drive_controller: RP2040/ESP32-S3 safety I/O and encoder controller
compute.mast_controller: separate RP2040 controller with hard limit inputs

ros.kinematics: differential/skid steer plus independent telescoping mast
